final: WITH group_stats AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), avg_counts AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM group_stats), kept AS (SELECT g.avg_points, g.record_count, a.avg_count FROM group_stats AS g JOIN avg_counts AS a ON a.avg_count IS NOT NULL WHERE g.record_count > a.avg_count) SELECT AVG(avg_points), AVG(record_count), AVG(record_count - avg_count) FROM kept
